notes: Phobos Manufacturing charges: the V4 refinery (machine refinery) and the Lixivar LC-3 leach and crystallise unit (machine leach), each in its own revision space. Every charge conserves mass to the gram of its item units; the reaction, sources and rounding of each are in docs/development/manufacturing-refinery-and-chemistry.md. Water, carbon dioxide and ammonia products go to a linked vessel or store, and drawn water and ammonia come from one; circulates is water a charge needs on hand and returns; offGas is breathed into the room. Published revisions are frozen (frozen-process-recipes.json): change a charge by adding a revision.

hydrates.notes: Hydrate dehydration. CM-chondrite bound water 9 to 13 percent by weight (Alexander et al. 2012); authored 10 percent. The dehydrated silicate and oxide is the game's own gangue.

clay.notes: Clay hydrate dehydration. CI-chondrite and Bennu phyllosilicate water 18 to 22 percent (Alexander et al. 2012; Lauretta et al. 2024); authored 20 percent. 8 kg is no gangue multiple, so the residue has its own identity.

carbon.notes: Carbon extraction from the game's carbon/carbides block (often hydrated). Authored 50 percent carbon, 10 percent water, 30 percent silicate, 10 percent pyrolysis gas split 0.6 CO2, 0.3 CO, 0.1 smoke.

nickel-iron.notes: Nickel-iron casting from meteoric iron: kamacite and taenite metal with adhering rock and troilite, schreibersite and oxide inclusions (Buchwald 1975). Authored 80 percent metal, 15 percent rock, 5 percent slag. A melt: a long heat wait freezes it to slag.

steel.notes: Carburised nickel steel: four nickel-iron ingots melted with one kilogram of carbon in excess; steel takes 0.02 to 2 percent carbon (ASM Handbook Vol. 1), the rest leaves in Shipbreaker's remainder. Needs Shipbreaker's steel ingot identity.

ammonium.notes: Ammonia release from the ammonium salt crust: 2 NH4Cl + Na2CO3 -> 2 NH3 + CO2 + H2O + 2 NaCl on 56.08 mol of ammonium chloride (Raponi et al. 2019; De Sanctis et al. 2024, NASA Dawn). Ammonia goes to a linked store and is never vented; CO2 into the room takes the gram of rounding.

calcine.notes: Calcining the LC-3's leached residue: MgCO3 -> MgO + CO2 on its 0.50 kg of magnesite (5.930 mol, IUPAC 2013 molar masses). The 0.261 kg of CO2 goes to a linked carbon dioxide store; the clay matrix and 0.239 kg of MgO leave as the terminal calcined residue. The reaction absorbs about 118 kJ/mol (formation enthalpies: MgO and CO2 from the CODATA key values, magnesite from Robie and Hemingway 1995, USGS Bulletin 2131), 0.19 kWh; the 3 kWh charge energy is authored.

nickel-steel.notes: Carburised nickel steel as the V4's own product (Manufacturing 0.26.0; owner decision of 1 October 2026 that the mined iron chain ends in its own product). The same melt as the steel charge: four nickel-iron ingots with one kilogram of carbon in excess, of which steel takes 0.02 to 2 percent (ASM Handbook Vol. 1); the unabsorbed carbon and the iron oxide it meets leave as a kilogram of refinery slag. Our rounding: the carbon the steel picks up and the iron lost to the dross are taken as equal, so the ingots keep the 16 kg they came in with. Supersedes the steel charge for new charges; a charge already bound to revision 5 still settles as steel. Needs no other mod.

methane-pyrolysis.notes: Carbon-catalysed methane decomposition (Manufacturing 0.27.0; owner approval of the interdependency first slice, 1 October 2026): CH4 -> C + 2 H2 on 249.77 mol, methane drawn from a linked methane store and hydrogen to a linked hydrogen store. A carbon stock is the bed: elemental carbon catalyses the cracking and the carbon made deposits on it, so the whole bed leaves as carbon black (catalysis of methane decomposition over elemental carbon: N. Muradov, Catalysis Communications 2, 2001; to cite exactly before quoting). 4.007 kg of methane gives 3.000 kg of carbon and 1.007 kg of hydrogen (IUPAC 2013 molar masses). With the K2 this is the Bosch reaction overall, CO2 + 2 H2 -> C + 2 H2O: the Sabatier's methane comes back as hydrogen and solid carbon. The decomposition absorbs 74.87 kJ per mole (CODATA formation enthalpy of methane), 5.19 kWh, from the charge's 12 kWh. The carbon black is priced so a loop through bought water and CO2 never pays.

carbon-burn.notes: A carbon burner for grow rooms (Manufacturing 0.27.0): C + O2 -> CO2 on 83.26 mol, oxygen drawn from a linked oxygen store and the carbon dioxide to a linked carbon dioxide store, for an A2 to dose crops where no other source is aboard. Complete combustion with stored oxygen in excess at the hearth is authored (no carbon monoxide). The burn releases 393.51 kJ per mole (CODATA), 9.10 kWh, into the room over the half hour.

scrubber-reactivation.notes: Reactivating the game's spent CO2 scrubber cartridges (Manufacturing 0.27.0; owner decision 7 of 1 October 2026): four spent cartridges give back three ready ones and one exhausted sorbent remainder. Authored, not a chemistry claim: the game's scrubber pumps the CO2 it catches into a canister, so a spent cartridge holds none and the charge releases none, and real lithium hydroxide is not regenerated by heat alone. A quarter of each batch is lost every pass.

eva-filter-reactivation.notes: Reactivating the game's spent EVA CO2 filters (Manufacturing 0.27.0), on the same authored terms as the scrubber cartridges: four spent give three ready and one exhausted sorbent remainder.

evaporite-leach.notes: Leach and glaserite-route crystallisation of the evaporite crust in 20 kg of circulating water: 2 KCl + Na2SO4 -> K2SO4 + 2 NaCl, KCl limiting at 8.048 mol (route: US patents 4,215,100 and 6,143,271). Potassium sulfate 0.701 kg; the Na,Mg phosphate (0.250 kg) is wet-separated; halite, the NaCl made, the leftover thenardite, trona and villiaumite leave as the terminal brine salt cake (2.248 kg); the clay matrix and magnesite leave as the leached residue for the V4. Rounded to item units, the gram of rounding to the cake. The water is condensed and returned. 12 kWh authored: a closed crystalliser with condensate recovery, about a quarter of open-pan evaporation at 2.26 MJ/kg (NIST). Crust minerals after McCoy et al. 2025 (NASA OSIRIS-REx Bennu samples); the proportions are authored.

struvite.notes: Struvite precipitation from the crust's own Na,Mg phosphate (our simplification): NaMgPO4 + NH3 + 7 H2O -> MgNH4PO4.6H2O + NaOH on 1.757 mol (struvite recovery reviewed in Environmental Evidence 9:34, 2020). Ammonia 0.030 kg from a linked ammonia store and 0.222 kg of hydration water from a linked water vessel give 0.431 kg of struvite; the sodium hydroxide is the terminal caustic remainder. Rounded to item units, the 2 g of rounding to the water drawn. 1 kWh authored (mixing and a low-temperature dry).

makeup-formulation.notes: Blending one potassium sulfate unit with two struvite units into Verdemorrow Groundwork makeup salts: 0.70 + 0.86 kg makes 39 packets of 40 g with nothing left over (potassium, sulfur, nitrogen, phosphorus and magnesium in the one aggregate figure Agriculture's nutrient model uses). Needs Agriculture's makeup packet identity. The packets carry Agriculture's own price (owner decision, 30 September 2026). 0.5 kWh authored.

sulfide-roast.notes: Roasting a sulfide-phosphide nodule (authored 7.000 kg troilite FeS, 1.058 kg schreibersite as Fe2NiP, 1.942 kg silicate, the phosphide set so one flask holds the phosphorus of three struvite units; iron-meteorite inclusions after Buchwald 1975) and making acid from its gases. FeS + 9/4 O2 + H2O -> 1/2 Fe2O3 + H2SO4 on 79.63 mol (roast 4 FeS + 7 O2 -> 2 Fe2O3 + 4 SO2, then SO2 + 1/2 O2 -> SO3 over the converter bed and SO3 + H2O -> H2SO4 in the absorber); Fe2NiP + 13/4 O2 + 3/2 H2O -> Fe2O3 + NiO + H3PO4 on 5.254 mol. Oxygen 6.280 kg and water 1.577 kg drawn; sulfuric acid 7.810 kg to a linked acid tank; phosphoric acid 0.515 kg in a flask; iron oxides, nickel oxide and the silicate 9.532 kg as the terminal roasted calcine. Rounded to item units, the water and the calcine each carry three grams. The reactions release about 840 kJ per mole of troilite and 1,750 kJ per mole of schreibersite (formation enthalpies from the NIST and CODATA key values, from memory, and an estimated -160 kJ/mol for schreibersite; verify before quoting), 21.1 kWh a charge, all into the room.

olivine-epsom.notes: Leaching the game's olivine ore in sulfuric acid, as in the olivine process for waste-acid neutralisation and precipitated silica (R.C.L. Jonckbloedt, Journal of Geochemical Exploration 62, 1998). The 10 kg chunk is authored as 7.000 kg of olivine at Fa29, the composition Nakamura et al. (Science 333, 2011) report for Hayabusa's Itokawa particles, and 3.000 kg of pyroxene, feldspar and chromite the acid leaves. (Mg0.71Fe0.29)2SiO4 + 2 H2SO4 + 12 H2O -> 1.42 MgSO4.7H2O + 0.58 FeSO4.7H2O + SiO2 on 44.03 mol: acid 8.636 kg from a linked tank and water 9.518 kg from a linked vessel. 32 units of Epsom salt (13.824 kg, 89.7% of the magnesium) crystallise; the rest stays in the liquor soaked into the cake, and the iron is left with it as iron sulfate (our simplification: a real plant would oxidise and drop the iron first). The terminal olivine leach cake carries the silica, the iron sulfate, the undissolved rock and that liquor, 14.330 kg. The reaction releases about 434 kJ per mole of olivine (formation enthalpies from the NBS tables and Robie and Hemingway 1995, from memory except epsomite; verify before quoting), 5.3 kWh a charge, into the room.

struvite-acid.notes: The acid route to struvite (owner request for both routes, 30 September 2026): H3PO4 + MgSO4.7H2O + 3 NH3 -> MgNH4PO4.6H2O + (NH4)2SO4 + H2O on the flask's 5.255 mol of phosphoric acid, magnesium from three Epsom salt and 0.269 kg of ammonia from a linked store. Three struvite units (1.290 kg), three ammonium sulfate units (0.696 kg) and 0.094 kg of water returned to a linked vessel; rounded to item units, the ammonium sulfate carries a gram and a half and the water gives up one gram. The reaction heat, about half a kilowatt-hour a charge with an uncertain struvite formation enthalpy, is not modelled. 2 kWh authored.

crop-nutrients.notes: The complete formulation (Agriculture 0.27.0 hoppers): one each of potassium sulfate, struvite, Epsom salt and ammonium sulfate, with 0.252 kg of ammonia and 0.725 kg of sulfuric acid neutralised in the mixer into 0.977 kg more ammonium sulfate (2 NH3 + H2SO4 -> (NH4)2SO4 on 7.39 mol, the ammoniation step of a fertiliser granulation plant). 2.771 kg of crop nutrients go to a linked hopper. The nitrogen top-up sets nitrogen to potassium at the ratio of Hoagland solution (N 210, K 235 mg/L; Hoagland and Arnon, California Agricultural Experiment Station Circular 347, 1950); phosphorus and magnesium land near it, sulfur far above it, and there is no calcium, nitrate or trace element: our sulfate-and-ammonium blend is not a real hydroponic recipe, and Agriculture's crop model uses only its aggregate figure. The neutralisation releases about 275 kJ per mole of ammonium sulfate (NBS tables, from memory; verify before quoting), 0.56 kWh a charge. The hopper's contents carry Agriculture's own 1,500 cr/kg (the owner's formulation decision, 30 September 2026); bagged into bulk charges they sell like any other, and every salt in the blend is made aboard from mined feed. 1 kWh authored.
